name: Flohmaxx Beetzsee-Center

rhythm.de: Monat für Monat, an einzelnen Wochenenden
rhythm.en: Month after month, on single weekends

facts: open ground beside the Beetzsee-Center, outdoors
has run in Brandenburg an der Havel since 2007
around 200 private and commercial traders each time
free parking on and beside the site
portable toilets, cleaned by the organiser
a few covered pitches, which cannot be reserved
pitches are handed out from 06:00 without registration, first come first served
private and commercial second-hand goods, antiques and new goods are all allowed
easy to reach from the Brandenburg motorway exit or by public transport
notes: Dates are the organiser's own "Kommende Termine" list on the location page — 3 and 4 October, 31 October and 1 November 2026, all 09:00 to 16:00; nothing after 1 November is published yet, so December and January are empty. Hours, the free-entry line and the site facts come from the organiser's dated page for 3 October. Coordinates are the ones in the organiser's own map link on the location page (52.432919, 12.548954). Flohmaxx also runs Bernau (Obi), Prenzlau and Strausberg in Brandenburg — separate markets, not this one.

description.de: An einzelnen Wochenenden von 9 bis 16 Uhr auf dem Freigelände am Beetzsee-Center, seit 2007. Rund 200 private und gewerbliche Verkäufer, Eintritt und Parken frei, bei jedem Wetter. Plätze werden ab 6 Uhr ohne Anmeldung vergeben; ein paar überdachte gibt es, reservieren lassen sie sich nicht.
description.en: On single weekends from 9 to 4 on the open ground beside the Beetzsee-Center, and running since 2007. Around 200 private and commercial sellers, free entry and parking, any weather. Pitches go from 6 with no registration; a few are covered and cannot be reserved.
